cniImage.description: The calico cni image path and tag

clusterCIDR.description: The CIDR pool used to assign IP addresses to the pods in the cluster

ipv4AutodetectionMethod.description: The method to use to autodetect the IPv4 address for this host. If it is empty then the first-found method is used.

ipv6AutodetectionMethod.description: The method to use to autodetect the IPv6 address for this host. If it is empty then the first-found method is used.

skipCNIBinaries.description: Skip the cni plugin binaries installation

image.description: The image repo and its pull policy

kubeControllerImage.description: The calico kube controllers image path and tag

nodeImage.description: The calico node image path and tag

podDaemonImage.description: The calico pod2daemon image path and tag

maxSurge.description: The maxSurge of rollingUpdate. Applied only if RollingUpdate is used as updateStrategy

maxUnavailable.description: The maxUnavailable of rollingUpdate. Applied only if RollingUpdate is used as updateStrategy

ipFamily.description: The IP family calico should be configured with

namespace.description: The namespace in which calico is deployed

nodeSelector.description: NodeSelector configuration applied to all the deployments
